summary: Create AI model and data risk registers, map controls and plan incident escalation. Explore this practical AI risk management training.
lede: AI risk management training helps risk, compliance, audit and AI product professionals assess AI system risks and connect them to accountable controls. You practise building model and data risk registers, mapping control ownership and evidence, triaging incidents, and turning findings into oversight reports for existing risk and assurance workflows.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who assess, oversee or audit AI systems in regulated or control-intensive environments. It is designed for practitioners who need to connect AI-specific risks with existing risk, compliance and assurance workflows.
modules: NIST AI RMF and AI Risk Scope
AI Risk Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prior experience in risk management, compliance, internal audit, AI product ownership or a related control function is recommended. You do not need to code or build machine-learning models; exercises focus on risk assessment, documentation and governance decisions.
